gloss: to pay attention to; to direct one's attention to

definitions.gloss: to pay attention to; to direct one's attention to
definitions.explanation: To consciously focus one's awareness or attention on a particular thing or direction.

examples.japanese: {周囲|しゅうい}に{注意|ちゅうい}を{向|む}ける。
{子|こ}どもの{変化|へんか}に{注意|ちゅうい}を{向|む}けてください。
examples.english: Please pay attention to changes in your child.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}にもっと{注意|ちゅうい}を{向|む}けるべきだ。
examples.english: You should pay more attention to your health.

examples.japanese: {社会|しゃかい}{問題|もんだい}に{注意|ちゅうい}を{向|む}ける{人|ひと}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: More people are turning their attention to social issues.

notes:
{注意|ちゅうい} (attention, caution) + を + {向|む}ける (to direct, to turn toward). A common expression meaning to deliberately focus one's attention on something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {周囲|しゅうい}に{注意|ちゅうい}を{向|む}ける: pay attention to surroundings
- {健康|けんこう}に{注意|ちゅうい}を{向|む}ける: pay attention to health
- {細部|さいぶ}に{注意|ちゅうい}を{向|む}ける: pay attention to details
- {注意|ちゅうい}を{向|む}けさせる: draw someone's attention

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {注意|ちゅうい}を{払|はら}う: pay attention — similar meaning but slightly more formal; implies careful, sustained attention
- {気|き}をつける: be careful — more casual and broader in usage; covers both attention and caution
- {目|め}を{向|む}ける: turn one's eyes toward — focuses on looking rather than mental attention
- {注目|ちゅうもく}する: pay attention, take note — often used when many people focus on something noteworthy
